text:
alice: Evening rollout plan: US -> EU -> APAC tonight. Change window 23:00-03:00 UTC. Target build: v2.14.0. Canary in us-east for 15m, then staggered traffic shifting. Pinned model serving profile for Dedicated customers: redwood-prod-pin-2026-02
benji: +1. Capacity check: warm pool in us-east 120k tokens/min, eu-west 80k, apac-sin 50k. Can we reserve an extra 20k for burst in each region?@carla
carla: I can bump warm pool by 20k in US/EU only; APAC quota is locked by partner region until 02:00 UTC. We can enable soft-burst for APAC (throttled) instead.
dmitri: Runtime note: v2.14.0 changes KV cache layout (improved hit rate) — cold-start p95 might improve but 95th for long seq still needs watch. Rolling canary will exercise long seq.
eva: Oncall here. Rollback triggers proposal: 1) 10% error rate increase sustained for 5m vs baseline, 2) median latency degradation >150ms for 10m, or 3) quota exhaustion on any region. If any trigger, we pin traffic back to v2.13.8 and open rollback window.
alice: Agreed. Add additional safety: auto-fallback policy to a smaller model variant in-hosted if Dedicated exhausts. Deploy-bot, add canary health hooks to post to this thread.
deploy-bot: deploy started: v2.14.0 -> us-east-canary (slot: canary-7). Health probes enabled. Logs posting to https://logs.company/release/1738001234
benji: Canary smoke checklist: 1) synthetic load 30s spike 2) sample prompts from prod promptset 3) embedding sanity 4) token-cost regression check. I'll run 1-2 now.
benji: running synthetic spike now: `hey deploy-bot, spike 2000reqs 30s`
deploy-bot: synthetic spike accepted. Observing CPU/GPU utilization. Will report after 35s.
carla: Network note: route policy set to prefer local region endpoints. We'll only shift 10% to EU at first, not more than 30% per 20m.
dmitri: Observability: I pushed a quick trace filter to show KV cache miss rates and tail kernel selection counts. Link: https://observability/redwood/1738001234
eva: Running canary health checks now. Eyeing errors and latency. Ping me for an immediate rollback.
benji: Canary results: errors stable, p50 latency +25ms, p95 +40ms. KV miss decreased as expected. No token-cost regression on sampled set.
alice: Good. Start US ramp: shift 20% every 8m, target 100% in US by 23:40 UTC unless triggers. EU hold at canary until US steady for 30m.
deploy-bot: traffic-shift: us-east-canary -> us-east-20% applied. New routing snapshot: r-1738001234-1
benji: US metrics after first shift: errors +0.5%, latency p95 +30ms, QPS within planned envelope. Warm pool fill +12k tokens/min.
carla: Confirm burst reservation applied for US/EU. APAC still soft-burst.
dmitri: Note: watch memory pressure on long sequences. I set an alert: mem_pressure_region_us > 75% for 3m -> slack alert + page.
eva: Alert set acknowledged.
alice: After US hits 100% and stable for 30m we start EU ramp at 15% initial. APAC only after EU stable 20m, and we keep APAC max ramp 10% per 15m because of partner quota.
benji: Pre-emptive rollback plan: if APAC shows quota backpressure we'll divert APAC traffic to hosted fallback with quantization profile q4 while we troubleshoot.
dmitri: Also, if we see a model-quality regression above threshold, we'll auto-retry requests through v2.13.8 routing. Quality guard: 1% semantic fail increase on eval promptset over 10m -> rollback.
alice: Release notes snippet for support: "v2.14.0: KV cache improvements, kernel selector tuning, reduced p50 latency on 8k seqs, improved cost per token for short prompts." Add note about temporary APAC soft-burst.
benji: Noted. I pushed short release note to docs: https://docs.internal/releases/v2.14.0
carla: Quick ops checklist put in runbook: `runbook:deploy:v2.14.0 -> verify warm pools, monitor mem_pressure, apply pin v2.13.8 if triggered`
alice: If rollback happens, timeline: 0-5m detect -> alert + pin -> 5-15m partial traffic revert -> 15-30m full revert and incident call. Everyone stand by.
deploy-bot: us-east canary healthy for 22m. Next step: us-east -> us-wide roll to 60% scheduled in 8m.
eva: Oncall will shadow US ramp. If anything crosses thresholds I'll post "rollback now" and tag @alice @benji @carla @dmitri.
benji: Small note: billing teams asked to flag any token-cost anomalies; I gave them view-only dashboards.
alice: OK team. I'll post final go/no-go at 22:50 UTC. Thanks. :thumbsup:
carla: Cool. I'll be on standby for warm pool adjustments.
dmitri: I'll keep the trace filters active.
eva: Standing by.
deploy-bot: thread update: last check-in at +66m. All regions: us steady, eu at canary, apac soft-burst. No rollbacks triggered.
